# Astro Website Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Building an Astro website with TypeScript, components, and pages.

## Setup Progress

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements - User wants an Astro website
- [x] Scaffold the Project - Astro project initialized with basic template
- [x] Customize the Project - Project uses default Astro starter template
- [x] Install Required Extensions - No additional extensions required for Astro
- [x] Compile the Project - Successfully built with npm run build
- [x] Create and Run Task - Tasks created in .astro-site/.vscode/tasks.json
- [x] Launch the Project - Ready to run with npm run dev
- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete - README.md available in project

## Project Location
The Astro website is located at `.astro-site/` within the workspace.

## Available Commands
- `npm run dev` - Start local dev server at localhost:4321
- `npm run build` - Build production site to ./dist/
- `npm run preview` - Preview built site locally
- `npm run astro ...` - Run Astro CLI commands
